entities.name: Otaria Chasm
entities.description: A cleft in northern Otaria beneath the Cliffs of Onara, formed as part of the Aboshan Trench.

entities.name: Rillu Veza
entities.description: Mapped the chasm and named it Loqar's Folly.

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: Leader who trapped Laquatus's army in the chasm.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Mer leader lured into the chasm and later killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: A battle in which Llawan used the chasm to strategic advantage.

entities.name: Aboshan Trench
entities.description: A stretch of land that Llawan laid claim to.

entities.name: Mer civil war
entities.description: A conflict effectively ended by the use of the Otaria Chasm.

events.summary: Empress Llawan lured Laquatus and his army into the chasm under false pretenses and sealed them in with portals at each end.
events.quote: she lured Laquatus and his army into the ravine under false pretenses

events.summary: Llawan's forces hunted down and killed Laquatus's army, and Kamahl killed Laquatus in Krosa, ending the Mer civil war.
events.quote: Since Laquatus himself was killed in Krosa by Kamahl

relations.quote: Laquatus himself was killed in Krosa by Kamahl

relations.note: She trapped his army in the chasm.
relations.quote: his army was hunted down and killed by Llawan's forces
